headline: Stocks to Watch: Swiggy, HPCL, CreditAccess Grameen in focus
summary: Swiggy slips 5.5% on wider quick commerce losses despite narrowed net loss. HPCL retreats 1.9% after strong Q2 earnings, while CreditAccess Grameen drops 4.7% as profit surge meets guidance updates.

headline: Lords Mark secures US FDA for 200+ products
summary: Lords Mark Industries becomes Asia's first to get US FDA registration for over 200 surgical and hygiene products. Exports to the US begin in December 2026.

headline: Goldman Sachs downgrades Ola Electric to Sell, cuts target to ₹23
summary: Goldman Sachs downgraded Ola Electric to Sell, slashing its target price to ₹23, citing high interest costs, capex pressures, and leadership changes in the battery business adding execution risk.

headline: Havells India: Brokerage Views on Q2FY27 Results
summary: Nomura maintains Neutral with a ₹1,232 target, citing fair valuation. Jefferies keeps Hold at ₹1,220, noting 35% sales growth in September quarter.

headline: Jefferies maintains Buy on Swiggy, cuts target to ₹330
summary: Jefferies maintains Buy on Swiggy but cuts target price to ₹330 as quick-commerce adjusted EBITDA losses widen to a three-quarter high of around ₹9bn, while food delivery posts an in-line quarter.

headline: Jyoti Structures secures order worth ₹690 crore
summary: Jyoti Structures has secured a new order valued at ₹690 crore. The company's market capitalisation stands at ₹970 crore.

headline: Sun Pharma raises ₹78.2 billion in bond issuance
summary: Sun Pharma raised ₹78.2 billion through a bond issuance, falling short of its ₹100 billion target. The fundraise highlights the company's capital market activity.

headline: Welspun Corp US arm wins ₹5,500 crore pipeline order
summary: Welspun Corp's US branch has secured a major order worth around ₹5,500 crore for coated line pipes to be used in the Permian natural gas pipeline project.

headline: Nestle India logs 20% revenue growth in September quarter
summary: Nestle India reported 20% revenue growth in the September quarter. CEO Philipp Navratil highlighted opportunities in bold global flavours like Korean and ramen products, while flagging inflation and high input costs.

headline: Govt plans to cut stakes in four PSU banks to 75%
summary: The government plans to reduce its stakes in Central Bank of India, Punjab & Sind Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, and UCO Bank to 75%, while retaining three to four large state-owned banks.

headline: Indian Railways coal volumes rise 22.5% in October
summary: Indian Railways recorded a 22.5% rise in coal transportation volumes in October, driven by higher power demand and increased coal movement across the network.

headline: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM for ₹2,112 crore
summary: UBS has acquired a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM for ₹2,112 crore, marking a significant institutional investment in the Indian wealth management firm.

headline: Govt plans to cut stake in four PSU banks to 75%
summary: The government plans to reduce its stakes in Central Bank of India, Punjab & Sind Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, and UCO Bank to 75%, while retaining three to four major state-owned banks and advancing IDBI Bank's privatisation.

headline: Vikram Solar 9-GW cell plant on track for Dec 2026
summary: Vikram Solar confirms its 9-GW N-type TOPCon cell facility in Tamil Nadu will produce first cells in December 2026, marking a key step in vertical integration.

headline: Kellton Tech wins digital engineering deal with Middle East airline
summary: Kellton Tech Solutions has secured a centralised digital engineering project with a major airline in the Middle East, marking a significant international contract win.

headline: Oil India finds gas in Krishna Godavari Basin
summary: Oil India Limited discovered natural gas in the Matsyapuri formation of the Krishna Godavari Basin. Initial testing recorded a flow rate of 1 lakh SCUMD.

headline: Persistent Systems shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 32,046 shares of Persistent Systems changing hands at ₹5,820.00 on NSE, with a combined value of ₹18.65 crore.

headline: Moschip promoter pledges 13.21% stake
summary: Mayuka Holdings pledged 2,57,80,011 shares of Moschip Technologies to Infina Finance. This encumbrance covers 13.21% of total share capital.

headline: Shri Dinesh Mills promoter group plans gift transfer
summary: Bharatbhai Upendrabhai Patel to acquire 24.34% shares via gift from family members. No change in total promoter holding; regulatory intimation filed with BSE.

headline: Omprakash Partani raises stake in Capricorn Systems to 6.47%
summary: Omprakash Partani acquired 9,93,541 shares of Capricorn Systems Global Solutions via open market, lifting aggregate holding with son to 6.471%.

headline: Rama Shiva exits Biogen Pharmachem stake
summary: Rama Shiva Lease Finance sold its entire 4.04% holding in Biogen Pharmachem Industries via open market, reducing its stake to zero.

headline: SBI Mutual Fund raises stake in Elevate Campuses to 9.20%
summary: SBI Mutual Fund acquired 50,621 shares of Elevate Campuses Ltd on October 16, 2026, increasing its holding to 9.1997% under SEBI regulations.

headline: Rose Merc shareholder Harshree Haria acquires 1.72 lakh shares
summary: Harshree Anil Haria acquired 1,72,000 equity shares of Rose Merc Ltd via ESOP allotment, raising her stake to 6.07% of voting capital.

headline: SBI Mutual Fund cuts Pakka Ltd stake to 3.99%
summary: SBI Mutual Fund sold 1.47 lakh shares of Pakka Ltd on October 19, 2026, reducing its holding from 4.63% to 3.99%. The disposal was executed via market sale.

headline: Umiya Holding raises stake in MRO-Tek Networks
summary: Umiya Holding Private Limited acquired 1,750 shares of MRO-Tek Networks via open market, lifting promoter holding to 38.85%.

headline: Zydus Wellness responds to FSSAI notice
summary: Zydus Wellness received an FSSAI notice on September 24 and responded on October 4, asserting that its product-label claims are scientifically substantiated.

headline: India Services PMI rises to 56.2 in October
summary: HSBC India Services PMI rose to 56.2 in October from 55.2 in September, indicating continued expansion in the services sector.

headline: Mahindra & Mahindra shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,19,611 Mahindra & Mahindra shares changing hands on NSE at ₹2,825.00, with a combined value of ₹33.79 crore.

headline: LIC cuts stake in Info Edge to 2.99%
summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India reduced its holding in Info Edge (India) Ltd to 2.993% after selling 1.29 crore shares via market sale.

headline: Infosys sees ₹69.49 crore block trade on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 605,254 shares of Infosys was executed on the NSE at ₹1,148.05 per share, amounting to ₹69.49 crore in total transaction value.

headline: Praruh Technologies partners with Splunk
summary: Praruh Technologies Limited has entered into a partnership agreement with Splunk, a part of Cisco Systems, Inc., to enhance cybersecurity and data analytics capabilities.

headline: Chemiesynth Vapi board to consider NCRPS allotment
summary: Chemiesynth (Vapi) Limited scheduled a board meeting for October 28, 2026, to approve the private placement allotment of Non-Convertible Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares.

headline: Havells shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 4,11,062 Havells shares changing hands on BSE at ₹1,016.10, with a combined value of ₹41.77 crore.

headline: Hexaware to invest £9 million in Manchester centre
summary: Hexaware Technologies hosts UK mayoral delegation, announcing £9 million investment in a new Design and Innovation Centre at Manchester's SISTER district.

headline: Anand Rathi Wealth to host virtual investor meet on Oct 29
summary: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited will hold a virtual meeting with individual investors on October 29, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Jio Platforms IPO Day 3: Subscribed 6.78x
summary: Jio Platforms IPO sees strong demand on final day, subscribed 6.78x overall. QIB demand leads at 14.06x, while Retail stands at 1.95x.

headline: Core4 Engineers IPO Day 1: Subscribed 0.03x
summary: Core4 Engineers IPO sees muted Day 1 demand with overall subscription at 0.03x. Retail leads at 0.05x, while QIB and bHNI categories remain unsubscribed.

headline: Paras Healthcare IPO Day 3: Subscribed 0.41x
summary: Paras Healthcare IPO saw weak demand on Day 3, closing at 0.41x overall subscription. Retail led with 1.55x, while QIB interest remained minimal at 0.08x.

headline: SSWL Q2 profit jumps 212% to ₹1.2 billion
summary: Steel Strips Wheels posted a net profit of ₹1.2 billion in Q2, up 212% YoY, beating estimates. Revenue rose 61% to ₹19.3 billion with margin expansion.

headline: NHIT gets NHA nod for 449 km road assets in Round-6
summary: National Highways Authority of India approved four road stretches totaling 449.48 km for potential acquisition by National Highways Infra Trust under InvIT Round-6 for FY27.

headline: NCLT allows first motion for Cyber Media merger
summary: NCLT Delhi has allowed the first motion for the merger of Cyber Media Research & Services into Cyber Media (India). Shareholder and unsecured creditor meetings are now directed.

headline: Shree Cement Q2 net profit falls to 2.1B rupees YoY
summary: Shree Cement reported Q2 net profit of 2.1B rupees, down from 2.77B rupees in the same period last year, in line with analyst estimates of 2.1B rupees.

headline: Yogi Ltd appoints Rana Gopal Singh as Additional Director
summary: Yogi Limited appointed Mr. Rana Gopal Singh as an Additional Director (Executive) effective October 23, 2026. Singh brings over 25 years of experience in real estate and SRA developments.

headline: Tikona Communication issues corrigendum to EGM notice
summary: Tikona Communication Limited has issued a corrigendum to the notice for its Extra-Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for October 28, 2026, correcting post-issue shareholding details for a preferential allotment.

headline: Honasa elevates Vipul Maheshwari to CPTO
summary: Honasa Consumer Limited appoints Vipul Maheshwari as Chief Product & Technology Officer effective October 23, 2026, to lead AI-led transformation and agentic AI initiatives.

headline: Sakar Q2 net profit more than doubles YoY
summary: Sakar reported a net profit of 113M rupees in Q2, compared to 45M rupees in the same period last year, reflecting a sharp year-on-year improvement.

headline: Westlife posts Q2 net loss of ₹20M
summary: Westlife Development reported a consolidated net loss of ₹20 million in Q2, a sharp reversal from the ₹277 million profit logged in the same quarter last year. Revenue rose to ₹7.5 billion from ₹6.4 billion.

headline: Godrej Properties Q2 Net Profit Falls to ₹150 Crore
summary: Godrej Properties reported a consolidated net profit of ₹1.5 billion for Q2, down from ₹4 billion YoY and missing estimates. Revenue rose to ₹19.3 billion.

headline: SKM Egg Products Q2 profit falls 33% YoY
summary: SKM Egg Products Export Ltd reported a decline in Q2 net profit to ₹161 million from ₹242 million. Revenue dropped to ₹1.8 billion, with EBITDA margin contracting to 15.73%.

headline: KSOLVES Q2 EBITDA falls to ₹84 million
summary: KSOLVES reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹84 million, down from ₹120 million YoY. Net profit declined to ₹59 million from ₹84 million, while revenue fell to ₹359 million.

headline: Garment Mantra gets BSE fine waiver
summary: BSE fully waived ₹11.94 lakh in fines for Garment Mantra Lifestyle Ltd regarding Sep 2020 compliance lapses. Two other penalties remain under review.

headline: Shree Cement board approves promoter reclassification
summary: Shree Cement Ltd board approved reclassifying Ms. Riya Puja Jain from Promoter Group to Public category. She holds 2,050 shares, representing 0.0057% of total equity.

headline: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels IPO: 57% Rev CAGR
summary: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Ltd files DRHP for Mumbai-based retail jewellery IPO. Revenue grew at 57.45% CAGR to ₹5,387 million in FY26.

headline: KEC International YTD order intake tops ₹10,600 crore
summary: KEC International's year-to-date order intake has surpassed ₹10,600 crore, while its market capitalisation stands at ₹8,500 crore.

headline: Tata Communications raises ₹300 crore via CP
summary: Tata Communications issued ₹300 crore in commercial paper at a 6.75% discount rate, listed on NSE on October 23, 2026.

headline: Solex Energy unveils India's first N-Type quarter cell solar module
summary: Solex Energy Limited launched TAPI RQ, India's first N-Type Quarter Cell Solar Module, at REI 2026. The module offers up to 670 Wp power output and 24.80% efficiency, marking the company's third consecutive year of introducing differentiated solar innovations.

headline: Elin Electronics approves director re-appointments
summary: Elin Electronics shareholders approved the re-appointment of Mangilall and Kamal Sethia as directors. Independent directors Sarnot and Guha were also re-appointed for second terms.

headline: Ultramarine promoter group seeks reclassification to public
summary: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd received requests from two promoter group members, Narayan Santhanam and Deepa Ajay, to reclassify their holdings as public shareholders under SEBI Regulation 31A.

headline: GK Energy wins ₹330.29 crore solar pump order
summary: GK Energy secures a ₹330.29 crore order from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. for 14,000 off-grid DC solar pumping systems, with completion expected within 60 days.

headline: Sterlite Tech Q2 EBITDA jumps to ₹8.12B
summary: Sterlite Technologies reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹8.12 billion, up from ₹1.3 billion YoY. Revenue rose to ₹25.3 billion, with margins expanding to 32.11%.

headline: Tembo subsidiary opens new defence factory in Maharashtra
summary: Tembo Global Industries' subsidiary, Tembo Classic Engineering, inaugurated a new manufacturing unit for defence products in Amravati, Maharashtra. The facility will produce ordnance and surveillance equipment.

headline: PNB Housing allots ₹253.65 Cr NCDs at 8.46%
summary: PNB Housing Finance Limited allotted 25,365 NCDs worth ₹253.65 crore on October 23, 2026. The five-year debentures carry a coupon rate of 8.4552% and are listed on the NSE.

headline: Home First Finance shifts Q2FY27 call to 5:30 pm
summary: Home First Finance Company India Ltd revised its Q2FY27 earnings call time to 5:30 pm IST on Oct 28, 2026. Management will discuss reviewed financial results.

headline: DMR Engineering H1FY27 profit rises 68% YoY
summary: DMR Engineering Ltd reported a 68.3% jump in standalone net profit to ₹224.95 lakh for H1FY27, driven by strong revenue growth and margin expansion.

headline: Shree Digvijay Cement posts Q2 net loss of ₹163M
summary: Shree Digvijay Cement reported a Q2 net loss of ₹163M against a profit of ₹102M YoY. Revenue rose to ₹2.79B, but EBITDA turned negative at ₹17M.

headline: C-DAC and Bank of India partner on quantum tech
summary: C-DAC and Bank of India have joined hands to advance indigenous quantum technologies for banking applications, marking a significant step in India's quantum computing push.

headline: Sukhjit Starch files Q2FY27 results, reconstitutes board committees
summary: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals filed unaudited standalone and consolidated results for Q2FY27 on October 23, 2026. The company also announced the reconstitution of key board committees following the induction of new independent directors.

headline: CSB Bank Q2 net profit rises to ₹1.8B, beats estimates
summary: CSB Bank reported a standalone net profit of ₹1.8 billion for Q2, up from ₹1.6 billion YoY. Asset quality improved with GNPA at 1.58% and NNPA at 0.33%.

headline: Newgen Q2 Results: EBITDA nearly doubles QoQ
summary: Newgen Software's Q2 EBITDA rose to 1.09B rupees from 559M QoQ, with EBITDA margin expanding sharply to 25.8% from 15.7% in the previous quarter.

headline: GNA net profit rises 41% YoY in Q2
summary: GNA reported a net profit of 441M rupees in Q2, up from 312M rupees in the same period last year, marking a strong year-on-year improvement.

headline: Regency Fincorp Q2FY27 PAT jumps 171% YoY
summary: Regency Fincorp reported a 171% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹900.54 lakh. The NBFC also approved a ₹40 crore NCD issuance at 12% interest to fund lending growth.

headline: Amwill Health declares ₹0.50 interim dividend
summary: Amwill Health Care Ltd declared an interim dividend of ₹0.50 per share for H1FY27. The board also approved unaudited financial results showing a slight dip in net profit to ₹367.39 lakh.

headline: Nalin Lease Finance Q2FY27: PAT up 51% YoY
summary: Nalin Lease Finance Ltd reported a 51% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹114.84 lakh. Interest income surged 51%, driving strong top-line growth.

headline: Camex Q2FY27 Results: PAT jumps to ₹104 lakh
summary: Camex Limited reported a net profit of ₹103.85 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue rose 21.7% YoY to ₹4,530 lakh.

headline: Suvidha Infra Q2FY27: Turns profitable
summary: Suvidha Infraestate Corporation Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹2.76 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing a loss. Revenue stood at ₹34 lakh, driven by inventory changes.

headline: Vikram Kamats Hospitality partially reopens Silvassa resort
summary: Vikram Kamats Hospitality Ltd has partially reopened operations at its flagship VITS Kamats Resort in Silvassa following flood-induced suspension. Core facilities are operational while secondary amenities remain under restoration.

headline: Aptech partners with FTII for film education
summary: Aptech Limited enters a collaboration with FTII to offer workshops, joint certifications, and co-developed filmmaking programmes across India.

headline: Ponni Sugars Q2 net profit jumps 48.6% YoY
summary: Ponni Sugars (Erode) reported a Q2 standalone net profit of ₹217 million, up from ₹146 million YoY. EBITDA rose to ₹335 million with margins expanding to 21%.

headline: CG Power Q2 net profit up 42% to ₹412 crore
summary: CG Power & Industrial Solutions posted a 42% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to ₹412 crore, beating estimates. Revenue grew 31% to ₹3,800 crore with EBITDA margins expanding.

headline: Mahindra Logistics turns profitable in Q2
summary: Mahindra Logistics posted a net profit of ₹262 million in Q2, reversing a loss of ₹104 million YoY. Revenue rose to ₹21 billion from ₹16.85 billion.

headline: Indong Tea director resigns citing health
summary: Madanlal Garg resigned as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director of Indong Tea Company Ltd on Oct 23, 2026, citing health issues. He was the brother of the Chairman.

headline: ONGC appoints Sunil Kumar as Chairman
summary: ONGC appoints Sunil Kumar as Chairman effective December 7, 2026. The appointment follows Cabinet Committee approval and lasts until his superannuation in 2028.

headline: SIP Industries issues revised AGM report
summary: SIP Industries Ltd filed a revised scrutinizer's report for its 36th AGM, correcting a description error in Item 2. Voting results and outcomes remain unchanged.

headline: Interarch fixes Nov 30 record date for 1:5 stock split
summary: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd has fixed November 30, 2026 as the record date for its equity share subdivision. Each ₹10 face value share will split into five ₹2 shares.

headline: Navkar Corp Q2 net profit jumps 168% YoY
summary: Navkar Corporation reported a net profit of ₹118 million in Q2, up from ₹44 million YoY. EBITDA rose to ₹333 million, though margins dipped slightly to 14.9%.

headline: Adani Power Q2 profit jumps to ₹69 billion
summary: Adani Power reported a sharp rise in Q2 net profit to ₹69 billion, beating estimates of ₹31 billion. EBITDA margin expanded to 42.34% as revenue grew 43.7% YoY.

headline: Rasi Electrodes submits AGM minutes
summary: Rasi Electrodes Ltd filed certified minutes of its 32nd AGM held on September 28, 2026. The meeting approved FY26 financials, a ₹0.20 dividend, and director reappointments.

headline: Talwalkars board to meet Oct 28 on share cut
summary: Talwalkars Better Value Fitness will hold a board meeting on October 28, 2026, to approve share reduction and preferential issue per NCLAT orders.

headline: SBI Cards Q2 asset quality improves QoQ
summary: SBI Cards reported improvement in asset quality with gross Stage 3 at 1.90% vs 2.04% QoQ and net Stage 3 at 0.77% vs 0.83% QoQ.

headline: Shriram Finance Q2 net profit rises 61% YoY
summary: Shriram Finance reported Q2 net profit of ₹37 billion, up 61% YoY. Revenue rose 16% YoY to ₹138 billion. Asset quality remained stable with gross stage 3 loans at 4.65%.

headline: Cyient DLM to host analyst meets on Oct 27
summary: Cyient DLM Limited will participate in investor meetings with Avener Capital and Carnelian Capital on October 27, 2026. MD & CEO Rajendra Velagapudi and CFO Subramanian RM will attend.

headline: Cellecor Gadgets appoints Arvind Kumar Verma as e-commerce head
summary: Cellecor Gadgets has named Arvind Kumar Verma as its E-Commerce Head. Verma previously held roles at Orient Electric and Haier Appliances India.

headline: JSW Steel Q2 net profit jumps 227% to ₹53 billion
summary: JSW Steel reported a strong Q2 with net profit surging to ₹53 billion, beating estimates. Revenue rose to ₹545 billion, while EBITDA margins expanded significantly.

headline: Telge Projects approves capital hike and warrant issue
summary: Telge Projects Ltd shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital and the preferential issue of convertible warrants to promoters via EGM.

headline: Sahajanand Medical adopts fair disclosure code
summary: Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited has adopted a Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI under SEBI PIT Regulations to ensure uniform information dissemination.

headline: Bonfiglioli submits SEBI fair disclosure code
summary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions filed its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI under SEBI PIT Regulations, 2015. The document outlines protocols for handling unpublished price sensitive information and defining legitimate purposes.

headline: CMPDI Q2 Net Profit Rises to ₹2 Billion
summary: CMPDI reported Q2 net profit of ₹2 billion, up from ₹1.8 billion YoY. Revenue grew to ₹5.9 billion, while EBITDA margin contracted slightly.

headline: Indian Sucrose VP Finance resigns
summary: Indian Sucrose Ltd announced the resignation of Vipin Kumar Agrawal, Sr. Vice President (Finance & Accounts), effective October 22, 2026. The move was attributed to other professional commitments.

headline: JSW Steel approves 5 MTPA Sambalpur expansion
summary: JSW Steel board approves 5 MTPA expansion at Sambalpur JV with JFE Steel, requiring ₹7,500 crore equity. Also incorporates UAE subsidiary.

headline: Ansal Housing fined ₹2.07 lakh by HRERA
summary: Ansal Housing Limited received a penalty of ₹2,07,867 from HRERA for delaying extension fee payments on its Ansal Town Yamunanagar project.

headline: Bonfiglioli appoints Sunil Kumar as CS
summary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions appointed Sunil Kumar as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The appointment was formalized in filings dated October 23, 2026.

headline: Bonfiglioli Transmissions confirms MUFG Intime as RTA
summary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited confirmed MUFG Intime India Private Limited as its Registrar & Share Transfer Agent under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Jana SFB Q2 Net Profit Jumps to ₹170 Crore
summary: Jana Small Finance Bank reports Q2 net profit of ₹1.7 billion vs ₹750 million YoY. Revenue rises to ₹16 billion. GNPA improves to 2.34%, but NNPA widens to 1.17%.

headline: Ashapura Intimates board to approve share allotment
summary: Ashapura Intimates Fashion Ltd board meets Oct 28, 2026, to allot shares following NCLT order on capital reduction. Record date set for Oct 26.

headline: Info Edge subsidiary invests ₹5 crore in Bijnis
summary: Startup Investments (Holding) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Info Edge, agreed to invest ₹5 crore in B2B footwear platform Bijnis. The deal includes primary subscription and potential secondary acquisition.

headline: Jindal Steel Q2 net profit rises 21% to ₹7.7B
summary: Jindal Steel & Power reported Q2 consolidated net profit of ₹7.7 billion, beating estimates. Revenue surged 43% YoY to ₹167 billion.
